# Ducksters

> > Educational resource for kids covering world history, US history, ancient civilizations, science, and more.

Ducksters is a comprehensive learning portal designed for students and young learners, offering accessible content on historical topics from Ancient Egypt and Rome to World War I, as well as science subjects like the Periodic Table. The site emphasizes kid-friendly explanations and educational resources across multiple subject areas.

## Key Topics

- Ancient Civilizations
- Ancient Egypt
- Ancient Rome
- Ancient Greece
- Ancient China
- Ancient Mesopotamia
- World War I
- United States History
- Aztec, Maya, and Inca
- Islamic Empire
- Black History Month
- Periodic Table
- Educational Resources for Kids
- Student Learning
- History and Geography

## Main Portal

- [Ducksters](https://www.ducksters.com/): Homepage for educational portal covering history, science, sports & more

## History Overview

- [World and US History for Kids](https://www.ducksters.com/history/): Main history hub covering US, world & ancient civilizations for students
- [World and US History for Kids](https://mail.ducksters.com/history/): History portal covering Ancient Egypt, Rome, China & US history for kids

## Ancient Civilizations

- [Ancient Rome for Kids: Romulus and Remus](https://www.ducksters.com/history/ancient_rome/romulus_and_remus.php?sa=X&ved=0ahUKEwjfx7rKyZbPAhWrB8AKHd1lDd8Q9QEIEDAA): Educational article on Romulus & Remus founding Rome legend

## Modern History

- [World War I: Overview](https://www.ducksters.com/history/world_war_i/): WWI overview covering Allied & Central Powers, trench warfare 1914-1918

## Science

- [Kids science: Periodic Table of Elements](http://mail.ducksters.com/science/periodic_table.php): Science guide on Periodic Table by Dmitri Mendeleev for kids
